request.story_prompt: A young girl named Emma discovers an old time machine in an abandoned laboratory. She accidentally travels 100 years into the future and finds a city in danger. Emma must solve a mysterious puzzle, save the city, and return home before the time machine disappears forever.

panels.title: The Forgotten Discovery
panels.scene_description: Maya, a young girl with messy hair and goggles, pushes aside dusty tarps in a dark, abandoned laboratory to reveal a glowing, metallic time machine console.
panels.image_prompt: Cinematic sci-fi comic book style, low angle shot, Maya with brown hair and goggles looking at a mysterious glowing console in a dilapidated lab, dust motes dancing in light beams, dramatic shadows, high detail, 8k.

panels.title: Leap Through Time
panels.scene_description: Maya accidentally hits a switch and is enveloped by a swirling vortex of blue energy that warps the space around her, pulling her into the unknown.
panels.image_prompt: Cinematic sci-fi comic book style, dynamic action shot, Maya in the center being engulfed by a swirling vortex of electric blue energy, distorted lab surroundings, motion blur, glowing particles, intense lighting.

panels.title: City of Neon Peril
panels.scene_description: Maya lands in a futuristic city 100 years ahead. The skyline is dominated by floating structures and flickering neon, but the sky is turning a dangerous, ominous crimson.
panels.image_prompt: Cinematic sci-fi comic book style, wide shot, futuristic cityscape with hovering vehicles and glass towers, sky is a menacing deep red, Maya standing in the foreground looking up in awe and worry, vibrant neon lighting.

panels.title: The Final Puzzle
panels.scene_description: Maya stands before a massive, floating holographic terminal in the city center, frantically aligning geometric light patterns to stabilize the city's crumbling energy field.
panels.image_prompt: Cinematic sci-fi comic book style, close-up on Maya's focused face, holographic interface reflecting in her eyes, floating geometric shapes glowing brightly, intense atmosphere, sharp focus on the puzzle interface.

panels.title: The Narrow Escape
panels.scene_description: The city stabilizes as the energy field glows gold. Maya dives back into the flickering time machine just as it begins to dematerialize, successfully returning home.
panels.image_prompt: Cinematic sci-fi comic book style, heroic exit, golden energy wave washing over the city, Maya jumping into a shimmering portal, the time machine fading into transparent light, epic conclusion, cinematic composition.
